query: WITH updated AS (UPDATE skills SET project_id = $2, space_id = $3, name = $4, path = $5, deleted = TRUE WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id) INSERT INTO skill_events (id, recorded_at, sequence, event_type, event) SELECT updated.id, COALESCE($6, NOW()), ROW_NUMBER() OVER () + $7, unnested.event_type, unnested.event FROM updated CROSS JOIN UNNEST($8::TEXT[], $9::JSONB[]) AS unnested(event_type, event) RETURNING recorded_at
